intro.text: A market of river barges tied up side by side on a small lake of the Demon's blood, covering nearly all of it.

description.text: The market caters to the rich and is mostly visited at night. Bouncers keep out the wrong sort, and the less wealthy wait in queues. The luxurious barges are painted Demon Bright and hung with colorful lanterns, and the blood beneath lights their hulls with ever-shifting light.

About half the barges are shops; the rest serve drinks and host socializing and dancing. Gangplanks join them, and the crowd tends to drift through the shops before gathering at the drinking barges. Captains must buy a permit to moor there.

items.text: While out on bail, Abrim Flint spent many evenings at the Night Barges, where he tried to con women, usually around barges seventeen and eighteen. December went there to find him.
